Audience: first-time Minnesota Class D applicants, especially drivers under twenty-one, who need to know which actions put a new license at risk.
Why it matters to a first-timer: the suspension grounds [A01], the revocation grounds including test refusal [A02] and the limited license and cancellation rules [A03] are written test items and real consequences.
Level: low concept load but high sorting load, because the test asks which list a given action belongs to.
Prerequisites: the school bus, insurance and fleeing rules in earlier chapters.
